'''Clan Riverwander''' was one of the clans of [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. It was based in a [[Clan Riverwander (district)|district of the same name]] in [[Phemiss]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="CatCW" />
